title: StockSmart Inventory Planning Standard — Fill-To Level of a Consigned Bin Taking Over a VendPoint Item
content:
This standard of the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program sets the fill-to level of a new consigned bin that takes over an item the customer has had taken out of one of its machines under the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program.

### 1. The item and the machine

1.1 The transferred item is the item of the customer's most recent VendPoint selection removal made at the customer's request, and the demand machine is the machine it was removed from; where two or more such removals carry that most recent effective date, or the customer has none, no fill-to level is set under this standard.

1.2 Such a bin is consigned only on a program whose tier allows consigned bins; on any other tier no fill-to level is set under this standard.

### 2. Net vends and the three-month window

2.1 Net vends of the transferred item are the units of it vended at the demand machine less the units of it returned to that machine and the units of it credited there as vend errors; vends, returns and credits at any other machine are not counted, and an item with none of them has net vends of zero.

2.2 A row's age in whole months is the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month. The last three months hold rows of age below three.

### 3. The calculation

3.1 The weekly usage of the transferred item is its net vends of the last three months divided by 13.

3.2 The restock cover is 2 weeks, no cover weeks are added to it (0 weeks), and the carried share is the whole, 1.

3.3 The fill-to level is the weekly usage times the cover in weeks, which is the restock cover plus every added cover week, times the carried share, which is the product of every share that applies, taken to six decimal places and then rounded up to the next whole unit, never below zero.

### Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Net vends of the last three months | Weekly usage | Cover in weeks | Carried share | Product to six decimals | Fill-to level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 52 units | 4.000000 | 2 | 1 | 8.000000 | 8 |
| 60 units | 4.615385 | 2 | 1 | 9.230769 | 10 |
| 0 units | 0 | 2 | 1 | 0.000000 | 0 |

A product that is already a whole number stays at that number; any fraction above it rounds up to the next whole unit.

### Row age (hypothetical dates)

With today on the 10th of a month, a row dated the 12th of the previous month is of age zero (one calendar month, less one because the 10th is earlier than the 12th); a row dated the 8th of the previous month is of age one.
